Periodo ipotetico III (3rd Conditional)

Se + congiuntivo trapassato, condizionale passato

seh loh ah-vehs-see sah-poo-toh pree-mah sah-reh-ee veh-noo-toh

Forma passiva con essere e venire
Passive voice in formal and journalistic Italian
essere/venire + past participle (+ da agent)
Il progetto viene approvato oggi.
eel proh-jeht-toh vyeh-neh ahp-proh-vah-toh ohj-jee
The project is being approved today.
venire for action
venire emphasizes the ongoing action, whereas essere can describe a resulting state.
